posts.text: Shree Refrigerations has received a ₹3.93 Cr order from the Indian Navy for a Magnetic Bearing Compressor-based AC Plant. Its a small order but it shows that Indian navy trusts shree when it comes to HVAC and further orders should soon follow after 90k cr deal with Germany and other frigates in the pipeline Screenshot 2026-08-30 at 10.24.19 PM 948×1288 135 KB
